title: Mixed Event — Unnamed Harmony — Episode1 Going Pro

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to try and go pro, and is practicing with more effort than ever. To make their own song to perform at shows, they decide to each come up with different parts to compare. Wanting to be of help to the band, Saki works harder than anyone else on her contribution, but...

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! We're gonna have another great practice today♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's head to SEKAI already!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki, keep it down.
Everybody can hear you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And like I told you a second ago, there's still too many people around today so we'll have to wait a little more until we do head over.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ever since we played that show, she's been as worked up as ever.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We may've just been the opening act, but we finally got a chance to perform together. The crowd seemed really into it towards the end too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, it was sooo much fun!
I wanna do a show like that again!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. But don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course, I'll be extra careful! But we're still gonna practice lots and lots♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We all decided to try and go pro, together. Since then, I've been having a lot more fun trying stuff out on my synthesizer instead of going out somewhere!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? I never thought I'd hear you say anything like that, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know, right? Honestly, I thought she'd be the one asking for more time off for us to go out together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! No, I wouldn't!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, whenever I start feeling tired, my mind might wander towards doing something else...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But wanting to get better and go pro with all of you always comes out on top! I've just never been this enthusiastic before!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. And we'd expect nothing less from you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we raise the bar a little for what we do during warm-ups?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You're gonna make things harder than before?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is that a complaint? You said you want to get better as fast as possible, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry, Saki. I'll just be adjusting what we do based on the level you've risen to...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Risen...? You're saying that I've actually gotten better? Yay! I love you so much, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
S-Saki... L-Let go...
I can't move...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No! I'm really happy because you praised me, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*... Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Didn't you say during lunch that you'd like to talk to us about practice today, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is there something you'd like to discuss?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sort of...
I guess now's a good time since we still can't head over yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tell us! Tell us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's about what we'll be doing specifically moving forward as Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What we'll be doing...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I get it! It's like our first meeting to plan Operation Go Pro As Leo/need, right♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When did you come up with that name, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Just now!
So about what we'll be doing...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right... This might take a while, so let's find an empty classroom where we can talk.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd like to start with what we'll need to do if we really are going to try and go pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: First, there are a few ways to become professional musicians...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! By auditioning and stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like those shows where the winners get a big record deal♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right, auditioning is one path that's open to us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Performing at live houses, getting better over time, and growing our fanbase is another option.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. An agency might scout us out after we've gained enough popularity.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. But it'll specifically be a record company instead of an agency.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Audition or earn fame through live house performances...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Those are just the most standard routes, but there are other ways of going about this too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Lately, some artists have been finding the spotlight by making videos and posting them online.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's cool...
You know so much, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, regardless of which path we choose, we're still nowhere near playing like actual pros yet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why we need to prioritize practicing, honing our skills, and getting experienced as much as we can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Getting experience...
Does that mean we should perform in more shows too?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, it does.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure you all felt it during our last performance, but it doesn't matter how well you do during practice. Everything can still fall apart while we're on stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For the very first time, we had a crowd of people hear our music and saw how they reacted to our performance...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're right. I couldn't sing at all at first because I was so scared. It was just such a big venue with so many people there...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I was so desperate to tell you how I felt that before I knew it, I was able to find my voice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too!
After I started focusing on wanting you to stay, Shiho, I was able to settle down and play normally!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right.
It felt like we all found the courage to rise up to the occasion.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was trying to say that we should perform while focusing on how our audience reacts, but... Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure as we keep playing more and more shows, we'll keep on improving too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not just technically either. We'll get more used to playing in front of a crowd.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right... I'd like for us to get better and see more people coming to our performances.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like that too...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's kinda scary, but really fun at the same time... If it means getting better, then I wanna do that too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. Then we can start focusing on performing in more shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
More shows...!
This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait either.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But how do we actually go about doing that? We've never even chosen where to perform before.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry about that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I asked the owner of the live house I work at and got the green light to perform in some events.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! You're awesome, Shiho♪
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have about a month to prepare for it, and I understand that it's going to be tight. Would you guys still be up for it...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
A month... I'm okay with that.
What should we play?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How about the song we played when we opened for STANDOUT? I feel like we'll be able to play it much better now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought about that too. But they're going to give us about 15 minutes to play, so we'll probably need two more songs to fill out our slot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, three songs?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That means we have to make a decision on our other two songs soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We do... Let's try going through the songs we've been practicing, some we might want to try and pick a couple out of that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. There are a few Miku songs that I've been wanting to try, so I'll make sure to look them up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But... It'd be nice to compose our own song and play it during a show too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our own song...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we'll have to start making our own songs too if we're gonna actually go pro. Just keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember Shiho mentioning that we're gonna have to start making our own songs!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It'd be awesome if we could!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. Performing the songs you personally made must be so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right?! Ichi and I tried giving music to some lyrics we came up with... But if we're gonna actually play it during a show, I want to make something better!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe someday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're okay with just someday?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Putting together a song that we can play on stage is no simple task.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'd have to figure out how we're going to do that too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we have you, Shiho, so we'll be fine, right? You've been playing for bands forever too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No way. Arranging music a little is the most I can do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! I didn't know that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A long time ago, I tried making some songs myself, but it ended up being too much...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I just wasn't able to turn what I was imagining into music.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
If you had that much trouble, Shiho, then it must be incredibly difficult.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I do want to make songs with you guys since we've decided to go pro together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And we can try our hand at it little by little as we practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
While we practice...?
Oh, in that case...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if we each tried coming up with riffs and phrases starting next practice?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Our own riffs...?
Like short melodies or chord progressions?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Coming up with a whole song at once is too hard, but I know we can at least come up with snippets of one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That does sound interesting...
But can we get that to work?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've never done anything like that before, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do it! Who knows? We might end up making something really good♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
Starting small sounds like a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can do that starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay!
Let's give it our best shot!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki's just jumping for joy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, since there are fewer people around now, shall we head over to see Miku and the others?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right, and I still want to talk about us as a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Let's go go go♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Our own shows, our own songs...
Hehe. This is sooo much fun!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm gonna give it everything I've got!)
